rationale.consistency: License headers, interface guards, RegisterHandlerDirective and standard/imports registration all match siblings; per-route Caddyfile uses time.ParseDuration while server options use caddy.ParseDuration.
rationale.edge_cases: Nil body, zero timeouts, hard-deadline cap and short ReadFrom all handled; but MinRate credit (transferred*time.Second) overflows int64 past ~9 GB and hard deadline is anchored at handler start rather than connection start.
rationale.scope: Deletes request_body's read_timeout/write_timeout (JSON and Caddyfile), a breaking change nobody asked for; per-route Caddyfile key is max_write_chunk, not the required write_max_chunk; adds unrequested rate args to server options.
rationale.readability: Clear structure and names; IdleDeadline docs are thorough though comments lean long with nginx/Apache asides.
rationale.robustness: Unsupported deadlines degrade gracefully with a one-time debug log; reader/writer have separate state so full-duplex is safe; overflow in rate math and no validation of negative rates/chunk sizes.
rationale.maintainability: Shared IdleDeadline/IdleTimeoutReader/Writer reused by server and handler avoids duplication; Caddyfile parsing for the rate pair is copy-pasted four times.
